decisions.reason: The account-transfer instruction does not change the duplicate page's requirement to omit the pricing section.
Exporting existing work to the new account does not change the monthly marker text, typography, or coverage.
The transfer method changes where existing work should be placed, not the required duplicate artifact or its duplication timing.
The workspace transfer instruction does not change the required panel count, removed panel, or pricing-section layout rule.
Moving existing work between Kajabi accounts does not change which Q&A box must be absent.
The transfer method does not alter the secondary control's label or required coverage.
The account migration instruction does not change the control's placement below the primary button.
The transfer method does not change the control's wrapper setting or visual styling reference.
Exporting and uploading the work does not change the requirement that the bonus section be removed.
The workspace transfer instruction does not alter the expected alignment of the instructor section.
The account-transfer method does not change any top-block layout or media-and-text relationship requirement.
The instruction to transfer existing work does not change the required top-section video or its playback behavior.
